title: data.pdf — section 7
text:
02-11
Changes to legislation: The Misuse of Drugs Regulations 2001 is up to date with all changes known to be in force on or
before 11 February 2026. There are changes that may be brought into force at a future date. Changes that have been made
appear in the content and are referenced with annotations. (See end of Document for details) View outstanding changes
[F54“supplementary prescriber” has the same meaning as in [F7the Human Medicines
Regulations 2012];]
[F55“therapeutic radiographer independent prescriber” has the same meaning as in the Human
Medicines Regulations 2012;]
[F56“veterinary prescription” means a prescription issued by a veterinary surgeon or veterinary
practitioner for the purposes of animal treatment;]
“wholesale dealer” means a person who carries on the business of selling drugs to persons
who buy to sell again.
